info.title: LibreEcho Device API
info.description: Local administration API shared by the mock and Linux hardware backends. State-changing requests require X-LibreEcho-CSRF. Device power operations also require X-LibreEcho-Confirm.

get.summary: Read voice-assistant state and latency telemetry
get.description: Reports subscription authentication, wake/STT stream health, and measured speech-end-to-first-PCM latency.

put.description: Configures ChatGPT or an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint, model, voice-safe instruction prompt, and whether wake-to-reply is enabled. API keys are write-only and never returned.

base_url.description: Configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ending in /v1

post.description: Polls at the server-provided interval and stores successful OAuth credentials in the device's private persistent secret store.
Returns a verification URL and user code. LibreEcho does not request an OpenAI API key.
Deletes the locally stored OAuth credentials and disables authenticated requests until device login is completed again.

post.summary: Stream a text request into spoken playback
post.description: Sends text through the configured subscription provider, segments streamed response text at voice-safe boundaries, and queues it on the local announcement bus.

get.description: Returns available audio state. On images without audiod, the 200 response contains data.available=false and data.unavailable=true; this is an expected capability result, not an HTTP error.

put.summary: Update volume, microphone state, or announcement voice

post.summary: Speak an announcement through the local speaker
post.description: Queues text for the warm local TTS service. Audio is streamed into audiod's priority announcement bus so external local services do not need direct hardware access.

post.summary: Speak a phrase into the microphone path
post.description: Renders the phrase with the device's own text-to-speech and plays it into the capture path, so wake-word detection, speech-to-text and the assistant process it as though it had been spoken in the room. Intended for testing. Nothing is recorded and nothing leaves the device.

post.summary: Create the first local administrator account
post.description: Available only when the configured users file is absent or empty. The first successful request wins and immediately enables user authentication.

post.summary: Invalidate the current local user session

get.description: Returns the Echo 9-lane transport endpoint, the seven verified microphone lanes, and the seven-entry logical miccal contract. Values are read from /proc/idme/miccal.* with 16384 as the fallback. Raw browser monitoring does not apply logical gains until physical geometry ordering is verified; audio is never recorded.

Streams microphone audio at 16 kHz using HTTP chunked transfer encoding. When the wake-word service is running, the endpoint subscribes to its shared calibrated mono stream (pcm_s16_le, one channel) so baby monitoring does not open a second ALSA capture. If wake-word is unavailable, it falls back to the selected verified raw microphone lane using the 9-channel packed signed 24-bit little-endian PCM container (pcm_s24_3le) carrying sign-extended 16-bit samples; lanes 7 and 8 are inactive or reserved. The source query value is card:device and channel selects 0 through 6. Authentication is applied when enabled.

200.description: Chunked PCM audio; format is declared by X-LibreEcho-Audio

get.summary: Read Bluetooth controller, discovery, pairing, bond and profile-service state
get.description: The response separates controller protocol capabilities from registered userspace profile services. Kernel RFCOMM, BNEP, or HIDP support alone does not make a profile service available. profile_state is pairing-only until SDP/profile services are installed and supervised. When the controller adapter is absent, the 200 response contains data.available=false and data.unavailable=true.

put.summary: Enable Bluetooth or update discoverable/connectable settings

post.summary: Start pairing with a discovered or known device
Enter or leave pairing mode and make the controller visible
Answer a pending confirmation, passkey or PIN request
Start a Classic + LE discovery scan
Remove a paired device and its stored bond
Validate, apply and persist portable configuration

post.description: Authenticated action returning a bounded, deterministic-ordered JSON diagnostic bundle. It includes public-safe release identity and available runtime, network, audio, wake-word, Bluetooth, playback, privacy, reset/pstore-summary and bounded log evidence. Wi-Fi credentials, SSID/BSSID, IP/MAC/Bluetooth addresses, owner identifiers, tokens, private paths, media metadata, signing material and raw pstore are omitted or redacted. Missing or malformed subsystem data is represented as unavailable without failing the export.

get.description: The `rest` item is the canonical LAN REST API state. Its `enabled` value mirrors effective LAN exposure and its `forced` value reports the development-only bind override; when forced, the corresponding UI control is read-only.
Returns available LED state. On images without ledd, the 200 response contains data.available=false and data.unavailable=true.

put.summary: Update LED colour, brightness or music visualizer preference

put.description: Night mode caps the ring to a dim theme on a local-time schedule. Because the schedule is local, the device timezone must be correct.

get.summary: Read association, gateway liveness, and recovery state
Read unified playback source, priority-bus state and optional media metadata

get.description: Reports explicit microphone retention mode (`audio_retention_mode`: none, local, or remote), bounded duration and size cap (`audio_retention_hours`, `audio_retention_max_mb`), and the remote destination state. Remote retention reports unavailable and has effective_mode=none until an authenticated HTTPS transport is present; it never falls back to local storage.

put.description: State-changing requests require CSRF. audio_retention is none, local, or remote (legacy 24h is accepted as local). Remote mode requires an HTTPS URL without embedded credentials; credentials are supplied out of band and are never exported.

get.description: Returns the OS version, source commit, clean/dirty source flag, and content digest embedded at build time.
Returns safe initial values and whether first-boot setup is complete. Wi-Fi credentials are never returned.

post.description: Validates and applies hostname, Wi-Fi, audio, wake-word and privacy basics, then requests access-point handoff. This one-time operation is rejected after setup completes.

get.summary: Read OS, NTP and PMIC RTC state
get.description: Reports whether network time has synchronized, the configured public peers, the last successful synchronization, and whether UTC was persisted to the hardware RTC.

put.description: A POSIX TZ string such as CST6CDT,M3.2.0,M11.1.0. There is no zoneinfo database on the device, so Olson names are not accepted. Daemons read TZ at start, so the change applies after a restart.

get.summary: Read signed A/B update and source-check state
get.description: Reports installed and latest verified versions, GitHub Release reachability, check timestamps and errors, pending activation, slots, rollback state, and whether the installed update helper supports unsigned manual uploads.

post.summary: Download, verify and install the available update
post.description: Requires a successful check reporting an available release, uses the same signed A/B installer as manual uploads, and does not restart the device.

put.summary: Enable or disable automatic signed update installation
put.description: Automatic installation is disabled by default and never restarts the device.

put.summary: Select the signed OTA update channel

post.summary: Check GitHub Releases for a signed update
Stream a LibreEcho OTA tar to the inactive slot
post.description: Manual uploads are signature-verified by default. The optional X-LibreEcho-Allow-Unsigned header is honored only when GET /api/v1/system/update reports allow_unsigned=true; it applies only to this manually selected package and bypasses signature verification.

get.summary: Read speech pipeline configuration and endpoint health
get.description: Reports local or remote speech recognition and synthesis engines, configured Wyoming endpoints, reachability, the on-device wake-word stage, and persisted listening settings. max_utterance_ms is 2000–20000, end_silence_ms is 200–3000, and vad_floor_rms is 1–1024.

200.description: Speech pipeline and persisted listening settings

put.summary: Configure and activate the speech pipeline
put.description: Persists and applies local, custom, or Home Assistant mode. Custom mode uses remote Wyoming Whisper and Piper services while wake-word detection remains on-device.

get.description: Returns available wake-word state. On images without the wake-word service, the 200 response contains data.available=false and data.unavailable=true.

Csrf.name: X-LibreEcho-CSRF
Csrf.description: Use the 64-character token returned by GET /api/v1/config; it changes on daemon boot.

AllowUnsigned.name: X-LibreEcho-Allow-Unsigned
AllowUnsigned.description: Set to 1 only for a manually selected package when GET /api/v1/system/update reports allow_unsigned=true. Bypasses signature verification for that upload; fetched and automatic updates never honor it.

WifiConnect.description: Wi-Fi credentials. `security` accepts exactly `open`, `wpa2`, or `wpa3`; when omitted it defaults to `wpa2`.

NetworkState.description: Association and independently verified gateway-liveness state

gateway_reachable.description: Null until a probe can be completed

reason.description: Sanitized installer reason token when an OTA update is rejected
